camera_orbit.observer: sequence of static observers at infinity; no camera-velocity aberration
camera_orbit.screen_basis: continuous rotation in a plane perpendicular to the disk

geometry.model: Kerr-Newman null geodesics; first opaque prograde circular thin-disk intersection
geometry.charge_definition: q=Q/(M sqrt(4 pi epsilon_0 G)); geometrized Q/M
geometry.disk_matter: neutral test matter; no Lorentz force or plasma response
geometry.spin_alignment: black-hole angular momentum and disk angular momentum both +z; prograde
geometry.integrator: double-precision RK4; Hermite equatorial root followed by partial RK4 event step
geometry.camera_angle_convention: signed degrees about disk x axis; n=(0,-sin(theta),cos(theta))
geometry.camera_screen_basis: e_x=(1,0,0); e_y=(0,cos(theta),sin(theta)); continuous through both poles
geometry.disk_plane_crossing: observer-at-infinity crossing excluded; coplanar rays first enter outer rim
geometry.delay_definition: elapsed coordinate propagation time minus one common observer Kerr-Newman r*; q-r*(hit)
geometry.azimuth: pole-regular angular vector plus backward Kerr-Newman radial frame-dragging integral
geometry.disk_surfaces: same prescribed isotropic surface emission on both faces

emission.model: original kinematic source, not NASA software or GRMHD
emission.radial_profile: general Page-Thorne conservation integral with neutral Kerr-Newman circular orbits; zero ISCO stress; peak=1
emission.normalization: exact azimuthal mean equals Page-Thorne at each emission time and radius
emission.loop_assumption: periodically repeated finite-lived source births; not repeating gas orbits
emission.retarded_time: evaluate at t_em=t_obs-delay for each ray

sources.role: orbiting/sheared inhomogeneities as a kinematic model
variable equatorial source, retarded time, orbital scales; not its stochastic solver
neutral Kerr-Newman circular orbits and metric
neutral specific energy and angular momentum, Eqs.19-20
independent published neutral ISCO equation benchmark, not the root solver

emission.spin_definition: a*=Jc/(G M^2); chosen model parameter, not a measurement
emission.matter_assumption: neutral test-matter disk in a fixed charged geometry; no Lorentz force or plasma dynamics
emission.radial_quadrature: cumulative trapezoid with analytic circular-orbit derivatives
emission.radial_lookup: log flux versus log(r-rISCO); quadratic unresolved edge limit
emission.dimensional_normalization: none; mass, accretion rate, temperature and spectrum unspecified
emission.surface_emission: two identical opaque, isotropically emitting faces

geodesic_reuse: 120 independently traced views; other 120 use exact antipodal isometry with new retarded source evaluation, no spatial interpolation

spin_configuration.matter: neutral test disk; electromagnetic forces on plasma are not modeled
spin_configuration.choice: user-chosen hypothetical spin and large net charge, not a fit to an observed black hole
spin_configuration.angular_momentum_direction: +z for both black hole and disk

layout.safe_area_note: Extra top clearance; interface overlays vary by device and caption state

encoding.rate_control: quality-targeted VBR with a VBV cap; CRF is not a platform requirement
encoding.color_conversion: sRGB RGB to Rec.709 limited-range YCbCr via zscale; pixels transformed before tagging
encoding.conversion_reference: display-referred: sRGB EOTF to linear light, then inverse BT.1886 (gamma 2.4) for Rec.709 display encoding
encoding.instagram_processing: Instagram generates its own delivery encodings; playback quality is not guaranteed by local export

display.color: original illustrative orange brightness palette, not thermal true color
display.averaging: physical bolometric radiance averaged before display transform

scene: original calculation; no NASA images, frames or source code used
time: 800 t_g shown in each 8-second cycle; same encoded cycle repeated four times for 32 seconds; periodic source forcing, full 360-degree viewpoint revolution; no physical mass assigned
disk_faces: same isotropic modeled emission field on both faces of a geometrically thin opaque disk
repetition_encoding: Four copies of one 8-second H.264 stream; lossless packet copy, no extra encode
